trigger.title: On being taken hold of
trigger.when: You begin to drag a card that still sits in its place in the grid. A card the Hand plucks out of the air says the same.

trigger.title: Under strain
trigger.when: You have pulled some 160 px from where you took hold, and the root begins to lose its grip.

trigger.title: Let go in time
trigger.when: You release the card before it tears. It springs home, and gloats.

trigger.title: Torn out
trigger.when: You pull past 350 px, or hold the strain until the root gives up. The card comes loose in your hand.

trigger.title: Thrown
trigger.when: A loose card is let go at more than 900 px a second.

trigger.title: A hard landing
trigger.when: The card strikes something at more than 500 px a second, and survives it.

trigger.title: The new buttons
trigger.when: After it snaps, a fresh Heads and Tails poof in and each says hello.

trigger.title: With the blade inside
trigger.when: The very tip of the katana has entered the card and has not yet come out.

lines: it hurts, it hurts, it hurts!!

trigger.title: Stabbed, not cut
trigger.when: The tip leaves by the same side it came in through. The card is not divided, but it bleeds for a while.

lines: it only went in a little

trigger.title: Cut in two
trigger.when: The tip goes in by one side and out by another. These are also the last words of a card torn in half between you and the Hand.

trigger.title: Shattered
trigger.when: A thrown card meets a wall, the floor or another card at more than 1300 px a second. Only a thrown card breaks; one that is dropped or carried never does.

lines: the wind knocked out of it

trigger.title: Stretched: the first degree
trigger.when: You and the Hand each hold an end of the same card, and it has begun to grow longer.

lines: I bend, I do not br—

trigger.title: Stretched: the second degree
trigger.when: The card is pulled past a third of what it can bear. Also said in the Hand’s fist, while it is being crushed.

trigger.title: Stretched: the third degree
trigger.when: The card is close to tearing, or close to being a ball of paper. The letters grow, redden and shake.

trigger.title: On the shelf: it has noticed
trigger.when: A card lies on the secret shelf and the Hand has started across the screen for it.

lines: it's not looking at me. right?
I do not like this shelf
huh, is it coming this way?

trigger.title: On the shelf: it is coming
trigger.when: The Hand is a third of the way there. The card shakes and hops and shuffles away from it.

lines: not me not me not me

trigger.title: On the shelf: it is here
trigger.when: The Hand is nearly on it. Pick the card up and it is saved.

lines: PICK ME UP PICK ME UP

trigger.title: Not me
trigger.when: Said by a loose card lying near the shelf while the Hand is coming for another.

lines: it wants the one on the shelf
it is that one, over there!

trigger.title: Begging
trigger.when: In the Hand’s closed fist, in the quiet pause after the second squeeze.

lines: Ripped it out! Stack them, or throw one hard to smash it.

trigger.title: Dropped
trigger.when: You let go of it.

trigger.title: Introducing itself
trigger.when: You tear it out of the banner, or double-click to take it in hand.

lines: hello! I'm the sharpest katana ever!
careful: I cut things just by touching them
sharpest blade in the world, hi!
don't touch anything you like with me
I am the sharpest sword in the world
the sharpest katana in the world, hello!

trigger.title: Boasting
trigger.when: It has just cut a card in two while you were holding it. It boasts about two times in five.

lines: one touch is all it takes
the sound of a clean cut

trigger.title: Cutting by accident
trigger.when: It cuts a card with nobody holding it, on its way down the page.

lines: A katana?! Pull it out of the ground.
The very tip of the blade cuts, however slowly. Double-click the katana to keep it in hand.

trigger.title: Wanting
trigger.when: You carry a loose card towards the right edge of the screen. Said again if you keep it waiting.

trigger.title: Taking hold
trigger.when: You bring the card within its reach and it closes its fingers on the far end. The tug of war begins.

trigger.title: In the tug of war
trigger.when: You pull against it hard enough that its grip starts to slip.

trigger.title: A card comes apart
trigger.when: A card is torn out of the grid while it watches, or torn in half between the two of you.

trigger.title: Eating
trigger.when: It drags its half of the card off the screen.

trigger.title: Winning the whole card
trigger.when: You let go during the tug of war.

trigger.title: Bored of it
trigger.when: It has held a card for two seconds. The card comes back, and about one time in three it comes back hard.

trigger.title: Sulking
trigger.when: You tempt it and take the card away, or the thing it was holding is cut or smashed.

trigger.title: Watching a cut
trigger.when: It saw the katana divide a card.

lines: I could do that with my nails

trigger.title: Watching a stab
trigger.when: It saw the katana go in and come out the same way.

trigger.title: Watching a card shatter
trigger.when: It saw a thrown card break.

lines: what a waste of a snack

trigger.title: Watching a throw
trigger.when: It saw you throw a card.

trigger.title: On the katana
trigger.when: It saw you draw the katana, or take it in hand.

trigger.title: On the katana, dropped
trigger.when: It saw you drop the katana.

trigger.title: A catch
trigger.when: You throw a card towards the right edge, and it plucks it out of the air.

trigger.title: Losing its grip
trigger.when: You yank the card away the moment it grabs, or take back the card it was celebrating with.

trigger.title: Out of patience
trigger.when: You have teased it for too long with a card just out of reach. The arm shoots out as far as it must.

trigger.title: Savouring
trigger.when: In the pauses of the crushing, while it turns the card over and looks at it.

trigger.title: The shelf
trigger.when: There is a secret written under the fog in the top right corner of the banner. With the shelf out, you leave a card lying on it and let go: it reaches for it, slowly.

lines: thanks for the meal… (said before eating)

trigger.title: Its hand cut off
trigger.when: The very tip of the katana passes through its arm while the arm is out on the screen. The hand drops, and the arm whips back out of sight.

trigger.title: A new hand
trigger.when: Some eight seconds after losing one. It comes back to show it off.

trigger.title: The crunch
trigger.when: The card it snatched is finally crushed.

lines: that is what teasing gets you

trigger.title: The question
trigger.when: Surprise me draws you a fortune and a project. It leans in beside the slip and asks, and asks once more if you have done nothing for seven seconds.

lines: I picked this for you. go?

trigger.title: Heads
trigger.when: The coin lands heads up, and it reads it out.

trigger.title: Tails
trigger.when: The coin lands tails up, and it reads it out.

trigger.title: Letting you stay
trigger.when: A moment after you win the toss, before it closes the slip for you.

trigger.title: Answering a no
trigger.when: Surprise me offers you a project and you say No. The Hand comes out to see about that.

trigger.title: Smashing Yes and No
trigger.when: A few moments after it greets you, it slams itself down on the Yes and No buttons. They fly off the page in pieces.

trigger.title: Its own buttons
trigger.when: It snaps two fingers, and Heads and Tails poof in where Yes and No were.

trigger.title: The toss
trigger.when: It throws a coin and makes you call it, heads or tails.

trigger.title: Beaten by a coin
trigger.when: You called it right. You may stay on the page.

trigger.title: The taunt
trigger.when: You called it wrong. It reaches over and presses Yes for you.

trigger.title: Not bothering with the coin
trigger.when: One toss in ten it pockets the coin and decides for you anyway.

trigger.title: Waiting on you
trigger.when: You lost the toss. Yes and No are back, and you have five seconds before it presses Yes for you.

lines: or I press it for you

trigger.title: Seeing you off
trigger.when: You pressed neither button for five seconds, so its finger is on Yes. You are leaving.

trigger.title: Knocking the buttons away
trigger.when: The first time you reach for Heads or Tails on a visit, it slaps, backhands or slams both buttons off the slip.

trigger.title: Snapping
trigger.when: Right after the buttons go flying. It has had enough of you.

trigger.title: Letting you pick
trigger.when: Half the time after it snaps, it lets you call it after all.

trigger.title: The secret is out
trigger.when: You bring the pointer near the bottom-right corner of the fortune slip and the hidden × rises out of it. If it was not already out, it bursts in to protest.

lines: you were never supposed to find that

trigger.title: Escaped
trigger.when: You click the secret ×, and the slip closes under its nose. Also when you lose the toss and press No anyway.

trigger.title: Hurry up
trigger.when: The coin is spinning and you have not called it. Four seconds in it nags you.

lines: I can do this all day
it is a coin, not a test

trigger.title: Picking for you
trigger.when: The other half of the time after it snaps, it pokes Heads or Tails itself. It also does when you leave the coin spinning for nine seconds.

trigger.title: You came back
trigger.when: It pressed Yes for you, and now you are on this page again. It noticed.

trigger.title: The rematch
trigger.when: It draws you another project and tosses the coin again.

lines: You cut its hand off. It will grow another. The old one has plans of its own.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: just fallen
trigger.when: Said by the hand that was cut off, lying where it fell and twitching.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: up on two fingers
trigger.when: After a couple of seconds it stands up on its first two fingers and walks off on tiptoe.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: picked up
trigger.when: You take it in your hand. It wriggles.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: thrown
trigger.when: You let it go at more than 900 px a second.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: it has seen a card
trigger.when: A loose card lies within about 500 px of it, on its level. It tiptoes over, faster.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: squeezing
trigger.when: It has climbed onto the card and closed around it, in the pause before the last squeeze.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: crushed it
trigger.when: There is no card any more. It does a little dance.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: sitting down
trigger.when: After a while of walking with nothing to catch. It gets up again by itself, or when something bumps it.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: dragging itself
trigger.when: Freshly cut off, it cannot stand yet: it lies on its belly, reaches out with two fingers and pulls the rest along.

trigger.title: The cut-off hand: running for it
trigger.when: The tip of the katana comes within about 280 px of it. It runs the other way on all five.

lines: I have seen what it does

棚 · A shelf. Pull a card out and leave it there.
The fog parts just for you today.

trigger.title: Bored of your reading
trigger.when: You keep this menu open for 5 seconds. The Hand comes in and picks something to do, at random, again and again: throw a card at the left edge of the screen, eat one, ask you to help rip one, or take the scroll. It says these as it arrives and as it throws.

lines: the sound of tossing something away

trigger.title: Swatted
trigger.when: You click the Hand while it is in this menu. It drops what it holds and stays away for at least five seconds.

trigger.title: Back, and careful
trigger.when: About half the time it returns from a swat wary, and creeps towards the next card slowly.

trigger.title: Back, and angry
trigger.when: The other half of the time it returns furious: it reaches fast, throws three cards in a row, and may take hold of the scroll.

trigger.title: Shaking the scroll
trigger.when: It grabs the right edge of the menu and yanks the page up and down for two to four seconds, so you lose your place.

trigger.title: Asking for help
trigger.when: It pulls a card out of this menu and holds it out to you. Grab the card and pull it left, and it rips in two: you get half, it eats the other.

trigger.title: Nobody helped
trigger.when: It held the card out for about eight seconds and you did not take the other end. It throws it instead.

trigger.title: Still scrolling
trigger.when: Half the time it does not let go after that, and shakes the scroll for a few seconds more.

trigger.title: Hiding
trigger.when: The other half it lets go, says this, and hides off the screen for a few seconds as if it was never there.
